digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five approved prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design must enumerate parity surfaces (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with disposition (in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason) to catch build-time parity escape classes.
Config-effect contrast test cases must prove each read config key CHANGES BEHAVIOR through the real read path (default vs non-default), not merely parsed, to detect read-but-miswired class bugs.

Contention trigger cases must route by operation shape (composed/check-then-act writes, write-storm/retry-reclamation, read-integrity-under-contention) to existing shared suites (two_clones, storm, sync_contention_harness) with no bespoke harness creation.
Behavioral gate findings must receive a RED test before the fix in the same change; non-behavioral findings (naming/docs/style) exempt and fixed directly.

Phase-5 residual-gap sweep must enumerate and disposition all out-of-scope slots from census, exclusions, compromises, and deferred advisories as filed/accepted-with-reason/fixed, with none as a valid outcome.
